# Load dataset

The meta SE object contains 122 animals from forced swim stress cohort, and 63 animals from acute restraint stress (ARS) cohort from @waag_2025. The aim of this section is to compare the results from these two cohorts.

```{r}
se <- readRDS(file = "./datasets/meta_se.rds")
table(se$Stressor, se$Sex)

# First we focus on ARS cohort
se_ARS <- se[ ,se$Stressor == "ARS"]
se_ARS$group <- paste0(se_ARS$Sex, "_", se_ARS$Condition)
se_ARS <- se_ARS[ , order(se_ARS$Condition, se_ARS$Sex == "Male")]
metadata(se_ARS)$hmcols <- c("darkblue", "white", "darkred")
metadata(se_ARS)$anno_colors <- List(
  Sex = c(Male = "#E1BE61", Female = "#40B0A6"),
  Condition = c("Stress" = "#006CD1", "Ctrl" = "#994F00"))

dge <- DGEList(assay(se_ARS, "counts"))
mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data=as.data.frame(colData(se_ARS)))
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
# Filter lowly expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, mm, min.count = 10)
# Subset SE to only filtered genes
se_ARS <- se_ARS[keep, ]

set.seed(1)
tmp <- SEtools::svacor(se_ARS, ~ 0 + group, numSVmethod = "be", method = "vst")
tmp <- SEtools::svacor(se_ARS, ~ 0 + group, numSVmethod = "leek", method = "vst")
# we use 2 SVs as suggested
se_ARS <- SEtools::svacor(se_ARS, ~ 0 + group, n.sv = 2, method = "vst")
se_ARS <- log2FC(se_ARS, "corrected", controls = grep("Ctrl", se_ARS$group))
saveRDS(se_ARS, "./objects/ARS_dataset_with_correction.rds")
```

# DEA

We use the same pipeline as in `reference_analysis.Rmd` to analyse ARS cohort.

```{r}
dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(assay(se_ARS)))
formula <- as.formula(paste(c("~ 0 + group", grep("^SV[0-9]+$",colnames(colData(se_ARS)),value=TRUE)), collapse="+"))
mm <- model.matrix(formula , data = as.data.frame(colData(se_ARS))) 
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, mm)
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, mm, pseudocount = 0.5)

#Define the constrasts to test for:
contrast <- makeContrasts(
  Stress_vs_CTRL = (groupFemale_Stress + groupMale_Stress) / 2 - (groupFemale_Ctrl + groupMale_Ctrl) / 2,  # Overall stress effect, averaged equally across both sexes
  F_M_Stress = (groupFemale_Stress - groupFemale_Ctrl) - (groupMale_Stress - groupMale_Ctrl),  # Sex*Stress interaction: does the stress response differ between sexes?
  F_vs_M_Ctrl = groupFemale_Ctrl - groupMale_Ctrl,  # Baseline sex difference (in Ctrls only) 
  F_vs_M_Stress = groupFemale_Stress - groupMale_Stress,  # Sex difference in Stress group
  F_Stress = groupFemale_Stress - groupFemale_Ctrl, # Stress response in females
  M_Stress = groupMale_Stress - groupMale_Ctrl, # Stress response in males
  levels = mm)

Results_interaction <- addlogFCSE(as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[,"F_M_Stress"]),Inf)))
# Difference in response to stress between sexes
Results_stress <- addlogFCSE(as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[,"Stress_vs_CTRL"]),Inf)))
# Average stress response across sexes

# use stageR to correct the Pvalue for interaction
Results2 <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, c("F_Stress", "M_Stress", "F_M_Stress", "Stress_vs_CTRL")]),Inf))
pScreen2 <- Results2$PValue
names(pScreen2) <- rownames(Results2)

pConfirmation2 <- cbind(Interaction = Results_interaction[row.names(Results2),"PValue"])

stageRObj2 <- stageR(pScreen = pScreen2, pConfirmation = pConfirmation2, pScreenAdjusted = FALSE)
stageRObj2 <- stageWiseAdjustment(object = stageRObj2, method = "none", alpha = 0.05)

adj_PVals2 <- getAdjustedPValues(stageRObj2, onlySignificantGenes = FALSE, order = FALSE) #returns NA for non-significant gene in pScreen
adj_PVals2 <- as.data.frame(adj_PVals2)

Results_interaction$staged.FDR <- adj_PVals2[rownames(Results_interaction),]$"Interaction"
intDEGs <- rownames(na.omit(Results_interaction[Results_interaction$staged.FDR < 0.05, ]))
intDEGs
```

# Stress-responsive DEGs

## Heatmaps

We first plot the stress-responsive DEGs for both FSS and ARS dataset, to see how similar they are

```{r, warning}
FSS_obj <- readRDS("./objects/reference_analysis_obj.rds")

se_FSS <- FSS_obj$se

stress_DEGs_ARS <- rownames(Results_stress[Results_stress$FDR < 0.01, ])
stress_DEGs_FSS <- rownames(rowData(se_FSS)$DEA.Stress_vs_CTRL[rowData(se_FSS)$DEA.Stress_vs_CTRL$FDR < 0.01, ])
stress_DEGs_union <- union(stress_DEGs_ARS, stress_DEGs_FSS)
stress_DEGs_union <- intersect(intersect(stress_DEGs_union, rownames(se_FSS)), rownames(se_ARS)[which(rowData(se_ARS)$proteinCoding)])

# First calculate two simple heatmaps for the input of commonScale (to unify the scales of two heatmaps)
supp_ARSa_left <- sechm(
  se = se_FSS,
  feature = stress_DEGs_union,
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE)

supp_ARSa_right <- sechm(
  se = se_ARS,
  feature = stress_DEGs_union, 
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE)

# rescale to the same scale, and set up the rest of the parameters
cs <- commonScale(supp_ARSa_left, supp_ARSa_right)
supp_ARSa_left <- sechm(
  se = se_FSS,
  feature = stress_DEGs_union,
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE,
  name = "z-score",
  # heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "z-score"),
  use_raster = TRUE,
  top_annotation = c("Condition", "Sex"),
  anno_labels = TRUE,
  anno_label_gp = list(size = 8, col = "white"),
  annocol_title_side = NA,
  breaks = cs$breaks,
  hmcols = cs$hmcols,
  column_title = "FSS",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

supp_ARSa_right <- sechm(
  se = se_ARS,
  feature = stress_DEGs_union, 
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  name = "z-score_ARS",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  top_annotation = c("Condition", "Sex"),
  anno_labels = TRUE,
  anno_label_gp = list(size = 8, col = "white"),
  breaks = cs$breaks,
  hmcols = cs$hmcols,
  column_title = "ARS",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  cluster_rows = FALSE
)

## combined + labels 
supp_ARSa <- as.ggplot(function() {draw(supp_ARSa_left + supp_ARSa_right, ht_gap = unit(6, "mm"), merge_legends = TRUE)})
supp_ARSa

```

## Scatter plot

```{r}
Results_stress_FSS <- rowData(se_FSS)$DEA.Stress_vs_CTRL
merge_stress <- merge(Results_stress_FSS, Results_stress, by = "row.names", suffix = c(".FSS", ".ARS"))
merge_stress$proteinCoding <- rowData(se_ARS)[merge_stress$Row.names, "proteinCoding"]
merge_stress <- merge_stress[which(merge_stress$Row.names %in% stress_DEGs_union & merge_stress$proteinCoding),]

supp_ARSb <- ggplot(merge_stress, aes(logFC.FSS, logFC.ARS)) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray") + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = low.ARS, yend = high.ARS), color="grey") + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = low.FSS, xend = high.FSS), color="grey") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16))+
  geom_point() + 
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = merge_stress[which(abs(merge_stress$logFC.FSS) > 1 | abs(merge_stress$logFC.ARS)> 1),],
    aes(label=gsub(".+\\.","",Row.names)), max.overlaps = 30, min.segment.length = 0, size = 3) +
  labs(x="Stress logFC in FSS data", y="Stress logFC in ARS data", title = "")
supp_ARSb
```

# Plot FSS and ARS interaction DEGs on both datasets

## Heatmaps

```{r, warning = FALSE}
intDEGs_FSS <- read.table("./objects/interaction_genes_swim_full_dataset.txt")
intDEGs_FSS <- intDEGs_FSS$x

cands_FSS <- intersect(intDEGs_FSS, rownames(se_ARS)[which(rowData(se_ARS)$proteinCoding)])
cands_ARS <- intDEGs
cands <- list(
  FSS = cands_FSS,
  ARS = cands_ARS
)
names(cands) <- c("FSS\nintDEGs", "ARS\nintDEGs")

supp_ARSc_left <- sechm(
  se = se_FSS,
  feature = cands,
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  row_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE,
  name = "z-score_FSS",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_legend = FALSE, 
  use_raster = TRUE,
  top_annotation = c("Condition", "Sex"),
  anno_labels = TRUE,
  anno_label_gp = list(size = 8, col = "white"),
  annocol_title_side = NA,
  breaks = cs$breaks, # use the common scales as before
  hmcols = cs$hmcols,
  column_title = "FSS",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_labels = gsub(".+\\.", "", unlist(cands, use.names = FALSE))
)

supp_ARSc_right <- sechm(
  se = se_ARS,
  feature = cands, 
  gaps_at = "Condition",
  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  row_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  assayName = "corrected",
  do.scale = TRUE,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  name = "z-score_ARS",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_legend = FALSE, 
  top_annotation = c("Condition", "Sex"),
  anno_labels = TRUE,
  anno_label_gp = list(size = 8, col = "white"),  breaks = cs$breaks,
  hmcols = cs$hmcols,
  column_title = "ARS",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_labels = gsub(".+\\.", "", unlist(cands, use.names = FALSE)),
  cluster_rows = FALSE
)

## combined + labels 
supp_ARSc <- as.ggplot(function() {draw(supp_ARSc_left + supp_ARSc_right, ht_gap = unit(6, "mm"), merge_legends = TRUE)})
supp_ARSc
```

## Scatter plot

```{r}
Results_interaction_FSS <- read.table("./objects/DEA_interaction_result_swim_full_dataset.txt")
merge_int <- merge(Results_interaction_FSS, Results_interaction, by = "row.names", suffix = c(".FSS", ".ARS"))
merge_int$proteinCoding <- rowData(se_ARS)[merge_int$Row.names, "proteinCoding"]
merge_int <- merge_int[which(merge_int$Row.names %in% unlist(cands, use.names = FALSE) & merge_int$proteinCoding),]

supp_ARSd <- ggplot(merge_int, aes(logFC.FSS, logFC.ARS)) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray") + 
  geom_abline(slope=1) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = low.ARS, yend = high.ARS), color="grey") + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = low.FSS, xend = high.FSS), color="grey") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16))+
  geom_point() + 
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data=merge_int[which(abs(merge_int$logFC.FSS)>0.1 | abs(merge_int$logFC.ARS)>0.1),],
    aes(label=gsub(".+\\.","",Row.names)), max.overlaps = 30, min.segment.length = 0, size=3) +
  labs(x="Interaction logFC in FSS data", y="Interaction logFC in ARS data", title = "")
supp_ARSd
```

# Figure summary

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 11, out.width = "100%"}
title1 <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Union of Stress DEGs From Both Dataset", size = 5, fontface = "bold") + theme_void()
title2 <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Sex:Stress Interaction DEGs from Both Dataset", size = 5, fontface = "bold") + theme_void()
spacer <- ggplot() + theme_void()
supp_ARS <- plot_grid(
              plot_grid(title1, labels = c("A")),
              plot_grid(
                supp_ARSa,
                supp_ARSb,
                nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(2, 1)
                ),
              plot_grid(title2, labels = c("B")),
              plot_grid(
                supp_ARSc,
                supp_ARSd,
                nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(2, 1)
                ),
              spacer,
              nrow = 5, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.05, 1, 0.02)
            )
supp_ARS

pdf("./supplements/supp_ARS_swim.pdf", width = 11, height = 11)
supp_ARS
dev.off()
```
